description:
Awetomaton is seeking a  Software Engineer  to support the TAP Lab at the Boulder Ground Information Facility (BGIF) in Boulder, Colorado. You will work with a small team to adapt, integrate, test, and transition a prototype application that detects and separates closely spaced objects in EO/IR imagery.   

 In this role, you will lead the software integration effort required to connect the Python-based prototype to operational message types, systems, and infrastructure. You will help transform research software into a reliable, maintainable application that can be deployed first in a testbed and ultimately in an operational Kubernetes environment. The application uses Python, NumPy, scikit-image, PyTorch, and Protocol Buffers–style messages. The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related field, with three to seven years of relevant experience.   

 This position must be performed on-site at the BGIF in Boulder, Colorado. An active SECRET security clearance is required. The anticipated salary range for this position is   $100,000–$165,000 annually . Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and other job-related considerations. We are considering candidates through September, with a planned start date in October 2026. 



 
 Criteria for success   

 
 Communicate effectively in written and verbal form with engineers, users, and decision-makers.    

 Demonstrate initiative when working with limited guidance or ambiguous requirements.     

 Develop reliable and maintainable operational applications.     

 Design clear interfaces and resolve complex integration problems.     

 Develop automated tests that provide confidence in software behavior and algorithm performance.     

 Collaborate effectively within a small, multidisciplinary team.   

 
 Required  Experience and Skills   

 
 Bachelor of Science in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related engineering discipline.    

 At least three years of professional software engineering experience.    

 At least one year of professional Python development experience.    

 Experience developing modular, reusable, and testable software.    

 Experience integrating software components through structured messages, APIs, or other defined interfaces.    

 Experience with container technologies such as Docker or Podman.    

 Experience with Linux-based development and deployment environments.    

 Proficiency with software configuration management using Git.    

 Active SECRET security clearance.    

 Ability to work on-site at the BGIF in Boulder, Colorado.   

 
 Desired Education and Experience   

 
 Master of Science in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related discipline.    

 Experience deploying and operating applications in Kubernetes.    

 Experience defining or integrating Protocol Buffers messages.    

 Experience transitioning research or prototype software into testbed or operational environments.    

 Experience supporting Python applications that use NumPy, scikit-image, or PyTorch.    

 Familiarity with EO/IR, OPIR, GEOINT, image processing, or sensor-data systems.    

 Experience with automated build, test, security-scanning, and deployment pipelines.    

 Experience with GitFlow, GitOps, GitHub, GitLab, or comparable team-development workflows.    

 Experience diagnosing performance, memory, dependency, and data-compatibility issues in distributed systems.   

 


  
 About Awetomaton 

 We build software that enables humans to make informed decisions from raw intel data, with a specialization in satellite collection. We are a Dayton-based defense startup that believes there is a critical skill & culture gap - one we are filling with high-output, mission focused engineering talent. Results matter to our customers. We've never lost a customer because we deliver what they need. Awetomaton is where you do work that matters with a passionate team in an environment that inspires your creativity.

 Benefits 

 We provide industry leading benefits that balance your health & wellbeing today, as well as lay a solid financial future into retirement. Highlights of our benefit plan include:

 
 Flexible time off totaling 36 days / year. No approvals required.

 100% 401k company match up to IRS annual limits. This is a benefit of up to $24,500 for 2026.

 Health plan through Blue Cross Blue Shield with Health Savings Account (HSA). We pay 95% of employee premiums including family plans.

 Employee favorite: Tech and Wellness reimbursement of $3000 / year. Treat yourself with the newest gadgets or athletic gear. No approvals required.

 Annual profit sharing as 401k contribution. No set percent and dependent on annual company performance. Benefit is above and beyond 401k match.

 MacBook laptop and well-equipped office spaces for optimal productivity in office and on-the-go.
